next_step: Run follow-up cost-optimization workshop; finalize batching & quantization profiles; produce revised pricing by 2024-11-10
notes: Lead: VP Product (Janel Moreno) - building in-app assistant + knowledge search for mid-market customers.
Initial ask: replace slow internal retrieval pipeline with embeddings+rerank; add chat assistant for tiered support flow.
Stage summary: started with Hosted API eval to validate quality/latency, moving to Dedicated for predictable throughput and data isolation if POC meets unit economics.
Demo (2024-10-18): showed chat + doc-search flow using a 13B open model. Janel: 'need parity with current heuristics but at 40% lower infra spend.'

POC plan: 6-week POC across two flows (support-chat high-concurrency; nightly batch embeddings for search indexing). POC metrics: p50 latency < 200ms (chat), sustained throughput 120 concurrent users, nightly embed throughput ~50k docs/day.

Cost workshop (2024-10-31): Redwood team ran interactive session with engineering and infra leads. Covered batching, KV-prefix caching, and three quantization profiles (fp16, int8, q4_0). Customer requested explicit unit cost modelling (cost per 1k tokens, cost per embed, cost per rerank request).

Workshop outcomes: agreed baseline batching policy (dynamic batching up to 32 requests for non-realtime rerank jobs), enabled prefix caching for common support prompts, recommended int8 quantized model for nightly embedding generation to hit cost targets.

Action items from workshop: Redwood to deliver a unit-economics spreadsheet (tokens/req, expected latency delta, projected monthly spend) and a Dedicated pricing delta for committed capacity vs hosted burst pricing.
Technical constraints: must support SSO/SAML, AES-256 encrypted at rest with KMS integration, audit log retention 1 year, model artifacts cannot leave VPC for Dedicated deployment option.

Model preferences: preference for open models with good quantization support (Llama family variants suggested), but Janel open to hybrid routing (hosted higher-capacity model for high-priority escalations).
Quote from SE (Noah): 'If we can get token cost under $0.0015 for hot chat paths and keep p95 < 600ms with prefix cache, they will move to Dedicated.'
Procurement notes: legal security questionnaire received 2024-10-25, expected completed by 2024-11-15; procurement wants 12-month commit for Dedicated with exit SLA.
POC milestones: kickoff (2024-10-20) -> mid-point metrics review (2024-11-05) -> cost-workshop follow-up (this ticket) -> final evaluation (2024-11-20).
Risks: regression on answer quality after aggressive quantization for chat; fallback policy required (auto-route to hosted full-precision model on quality drop).
Next steps (short): deliver revised pricing + unit economics, schedule technical runbook handoff for Dedicated install, secure procurement approval window.
